method: Named text-symbol comparison. Only explicit Kamek relocation fields and out-of-function unconditional branch displacements are masked. Local/conditional branches and instruction flags remain exact. Each masked target must resolve to the same named/sized symbol plus offset, the same offset in the compared function, or exactly the same native address. Unresolved references are not treated as matches.
limits: PAL text symbols only; no data/BSS/full-command-stream or runtime proof
Symbol maps must belong to their respective binaries; map ownership is an input assumption
Matching named targets do not prove the referenced implementations match
No claim of complete Corresponding Source
